paper_title: Few-shot Hate Speech Detection Based on the MindSpore Framework
caption: Ablation study on the HateXplain dataset. The line chart illustrates variations in precision, recall, and F1-score across different model variants of MS-FSLHate.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the variation in metric scores—precision, recall, and F1-score— across different model variants of MS-FSLHate. The x-axis, labeled “Model Variants,” presents a linear scale from approximately 56.82 to 65.44, with tick labels spaced at intervals of one unit. The y-axis, labeled “Metric (%)”, also utilizes a linear scale ranging from approximately 58 to 66, with tick labels incrementing by 2 percentage points. A purple line represents the precision score, beginning at approximately 59.67 and decreasing to 61.06, with a value of 61.06 observed at the x-axis value of 57. A light blue line represents the recall score, starting at approximately 57.74 and nearing 59.17, with a value of 59.17 observed at the x-axis value of 58. A light orange line represents the F1-score, beginning at approximately 56.82 and gradually increasing to approximately 65.78, with a value of 65.78 observed at the x-axis value of 65.
